01 / THE DIFFERENCE

Ordinary alarms ask one thing:

Did you stop the sound?

We ask something better:

Did you finish the reason?

ALARMUNLOCKWATCH OR READDONE

Stop the sound. Finish the task.

Your morning gets a purpose before it gets a snooze button.

Choose a goal, pair it with a full-screen message or motivation video, and decide how long you need to stay with it. The alarm ends when your commitment is complete.
